toegepas.voor: dieselfde suiker as die suiker in julle suikerpot
toegepas.na: dieselfde suiker as dié in julle suikerpot
toegepas.rede_vinder: Avoids repeating 'suiker' three times in one short sentence.
toegepas.fout: 'suiker' is repeated needlessly in one short sentence ('dieselfde suiker as die suiker').
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'as dié in julle suikerpot' is the natural Afrikaans way to avoid the repetition, and the meaning is unchanged.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'bokant' is the natural Afrikaans noun for the upper surface; 'boonste kant' reads wooden.
toegepas.fout: 'boonste kant' is a wooden two-word paraphrase of an ordinary noun.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'bokant' is the plain Afrikaans noun for a leaf's upper side and says exactly the same thing.

toegepas.voor: uit die grond op en dun buisies
toegepas.na: uit die grond op, en dun buisies
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma: 'Die wortels neem ... op' and 'dun buisies ... lei dit' are two clauses, each with its own subject and verb.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The AWS 2017 requires a comma before 'en' joining two full clauses.

toegepas.voor: om te lewe en te groei en verander 'n ander deel in stysel
toegepas.na: om te lewe en te groei. 'n Ander deel verander hy in stysel
toegepas.rede_vinder: The chain of three 'en' links makes the sentence hard to follow; splitting it keeps the meaning and reads more clearly.
toegepas.fout: Three 'en' links in a row ('lewe en te groei en verander') make the sentence hard to follow on a first reading.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The split keeps the same subject, both actions and their order, and reads clearly; 'hy' for the plant matches the lesson's usage elsewhere.

toegepas.voor: Dit verskil van plant tot plant watter dele die meeste bêre.
toegepas.na: Watter dele die meeste stysel bêre, verskil van plant tot plant.
toegepas.rede_vinder: The anticipatory 'Dit' and bare 'die meeste bêre' are vague; naming stysel and putting the subject clause first is clearer.
toegepas.fout: 'die meeste bêre' has no object, so it is vague which thing is stored most.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Naming 'stysel', which the whole paragraph is about, makes the sentence clear without adding a fact, and the qualifier 'die meeste' stays intact.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'met ... in' is colloquial; standard written Afrikaans uses 'daarin' here.
toegepas.fout: 'met baie stysel in' is colloquial for written text.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'daarin' is the standard written form and the meaning is the same.

toegepas.voor: om kos mee te maak nie en die jong plantjie
toegepas.na: om kos mee te maak nie, en die jong plantjie
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma: 'n Boontjiesaad ... het' and 'die jong plantjie groei' are two clauses, each with its own subject and verb.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The AWS 2017 requires a comma before 'en' joining two full clauses.

laat_vaar.voor: uit sy kos, en ook 'n dier wat die plant eet
laat_vaar.na: uit sy kos, en 'n dier wat die plant eet, kry dit ook
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The tacked-on phrase without its own verb reads awkwardly; giving it a verb makes a proper second clause that justifies the comma.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The elliptical 'en ook 'n dier wat die plant eet' is acceptable Afrikaans, while the proposal is longer and its 'dit' could point to either 'energie' or 'kos'.
